title: Travelogue Trip
description: trip.json v0.2 — single source of truth for visual-journal template

layoutEngine.description: Web layout: legacy (media-card/row) or screens (16:9 stage)

layoutEngineVersion.description: screens engine rules version, e.g. screens-1

templateSelection.description: Phase 13 template routing decision (optional on legacy trips).

intent.description: Phase 4 editorial intent (PRD-PHASE4 §4.1). Optional; mirrored to meta/userNotes via TripService.apply_intent.

placesUserSet.description: True when Studio user explicitly filled 主地点; false when default/blank so copy prefers magazine title over EXIF city

layoutDensity.description: Fine-craft layout preference: single-hero vs collage-heavy (PRD-FINE-CRAFT-LAYOUT-DENSITY)

photoCullEnabled.description: When false, skip Phase 9 photo cull for this trip (PRD-P9-F1); default true when omitted

keepNearDuplicates.description: When true, skip ingest burst/pHash dedupe for this trip (PRD-P9-F2); MD5 exact dedupe still runs; default false when omitted

featuredSubjects.description: Travel party members to recognize (seed photos per subject); duo = all listed subjects present

longShot.description: P0: include 保存长图 bundle in draft/share export (default true in renderer)

fontTheme.description: Optional HTML font theme (default ui / Microsoft YaHei stack)

copyDisplay.description: Render: full shows hook/lead/captions; photos hides narrative copy (trip.json unchanged)

profile.description: Reading experience preset (PRD-EXPERIENCE); expands scroll/present/longshot defaults

mobileProfile.description: Optional profile override for index-mobile.html (P5 · ADR-003 opt-in)

breathEngine.description: Scrub engine for cinematic/gallery (P5 · gsap loads CDN when set)

assetExif.description: Phase 23 · camera EXIF written at ingest

coverBlindReviewEntry.description: Cover blind-review snapshot for one export layout

coverBlindReview.description: Per-layout blind-review snapshot written by curate (cover selection v0.2.1)

algorithmProfile.description: Algorithm freshness snapshot written after ingest/curate

layoutStrategy.description: P17 LSE strategy trace summary (full log in runs/layout-decisions.jsonl)

degradationReason.description: Why smart layout fell back to legacy

narrativeScope.description: Copy generation scope used at last narrate run

phase.description: Phase 11 copy strategy marker, e.g. p11-lite-line

copyMetrics.description: Lite Copy v1.1 observability metrics (decorLine fill, edits, client events)

displayedAssetIds.description: Asset ids shown on screens (mosaic coverage / replan)

templateHints.description: Phase 13 template router hints written during curate

intentHints.description: Read-only editorial hints from Studio intent (Phase 4 M18+)

momentSecondaryIds.description: Phase 23 · pool members except signature (no extra screen)

momentCandidates.description: Phase 23 · Studio signature swap top-3 (diversity order)

momentCollision.description: Phase 23 · soft collision warning (e.g. same asset as closing)

aestheticAlignment.description: GAP-11 aesthetic alignment telemetry written during curate

confidence.description: Average HDBSCAN membership probability for cluster members (Phase 6)

embedStats.description: P7 telemetry: CLIP embedding run statistics

embedSkipped.description: True when embedding cache was reused and CLIP embed was skipped

coverOpeningStyle.description: Web cover opening layout skin; assigned at trip create

revision.description: Optimistic lock counter; incremented on successful TripService.update/save (ADR-008)

renderedRevision.description: meta.revision captured when index.html was last written; used to detect preview bundle stale without false positives from post-render metadata persists (G-LRG-08)

nativeWidth.description: Original source pixel width before WebP upscale

nativeHeight.description: Original source pixel height before WebP upscale

contentSig.description: MD5 content signature (size:hex) for cross-ingest dedupe

tags.description: Semantic tags from Agent 0 vision/heuristic; 3-5 recommended

userTier.description: User intent from featured vs material ingest folder (PRD-EXPERIENCE appendix A)

skipCaption.description: When true, hide caption and skip narrate for this asset

layoutEligible.description: False when excluded from cover/chapters/screens (e.g. low resolution)

signals.description: Numeric CV/ML signals; AA may add string metadata (learnedMetric, mllmModel, mllmShortlist).

cullBranch.description: Branch chosen by photo_cull quality scoring

cullBranchFallbackReason.description: Why cull branch fell back (photo_cull pipeline)

dominantTone.description: Average tone hex for spread continuity scoring

salientBox.description: Primary subject region (face box when detected)

burstGroupId.description: Time-proximate burst cluster id from ingest

eventId.description: Geo event segment id from Phase 3 clustering

sceneClusterId.description: Scene cluster label from embedding clustering; -1 = noise

slot.description: Wide/tall/square card treatment for render CSS

memoryAnchors.description: User memory hooks at G1; fed to Agent 2

copyIntent.description: Phase 11 · optional mood/focus/note anchors for decorLine

segmentId.description: Primary travel time segment for this chapter (most assets)

segmentIds.description: All segments represented when day buckets were merged across trips

layoutStub.description: True when items[] is a compact stub derived from screens[]

decorLine.description: Phase 11 · optional chapter accent line (<=30 chars)

layoutHint.description: Person portrait: 2-col pair, 3-col row, 4×2 grid (contain per slot); editorial row hint

arcSegment.description: Narrative arc beat for smart layout V2 (Phase 4 entry deep link)

role.description: P23.1 · inline peak pool screen role (moment = signature only)
